一年的时间说长不长，说短也不短。

凌浩的父母进了局子，公司被凌浩大伯接手，凌浩被扫地出门

凌浩在那次爆炸中被炸伤了腿，因为后续治疗费用不够，走路有些问题，一开始他想去找苏衣衣，可是南宫景根本不让他见苏衣衣，等他身上的钱越来越少，他才意识到自己早就不是那个高高在上的公子哥，也没那个心思去找苏衣衣。

最后凌浩不知所踪。

而南宫景和私生子进入白热化的争夺中。

有那个私生子在，南宫景绝对不会好过。

原剧情中，那个私生子出场的时间比较晚，那个时候南宫景已经彻底将公司掌握在手中，私生子也是有些能力，蹦哒了一段时间才被南宫景解决掉。

但是现在那个私生子出场的时间提前了，南宫景还没有那个能力，又有南宫政的暗中相助。

两人相争，最终胜利说不定就不是南宫景了。

当然私生子提前出场，自然有时笙的手笔，公司里那么多人帮着他，也是时笙拿了一些黑料，那些人不得不帮着他，不然以他一个空降的，别人凭什么那么帮着他。

至于以后，他能不能拿捏得住那些人，那就不关时笙的事了。

南宫景在公司过得越来越不如意，回到公寓，对着苏衣衣轻则打骂，重则凌虐。

一开始南宫景事后还会道歉，但是当苏衣衣试图离开他的时候，南宫景被激怒了，将苏衣衣囚禁在别墅中。

苏衣衣重来没想过自己变成禁脔，她每天活动的地方，就只有一个房间，南宫景特意改造了房间，里面摆放着各种道具。

以前她盼着南宫景回来，可现在她害怕南宫景回来。

每次听到开门声，她就恨不得将自己锁在密不透风的地方。

“咔嚓……”特意订制的指纹门被人推开，光线从门外透进来，驱散了黑暗。

苏衣衣缩在角落，惊恐的看着那个如同恶魔的一般的男人朝着自己靠近，他脸上挂着她熟悉的笑容，可是却让她觉得那么的可怕。

“衣衣，我们今天玩儿点好玩儿的。”南宫景居高临下的俯视着苏衣衣。

苏衣衣努力将身子往后缩，带着哭腔祈求，“不要……南宫景你放过我吧！你放过我，求求你了！”

“放过你？”南宫景呢喃了一声，随后大吼起来，“我放过你，谁来放过我？那个私生子在公司里都快只手遮天了，他会放过我吗？苏衣衣，你是不是想离开我？我告诉你，不许！你是我的，你不许离开我……你永远都是我的！！”

南宫景将苏衣衣拎起来扔到床上，直接压了下去，在她身体中横冲直撞，没有半分的温柔。

“你是我的……衣衣不要离开我，说你爱我……我只有你了，你不能离开我……”

A year is neither long nor short.

Ling Hao's parents got into trouble, the company was taken over by Ling Hao's uncle, and Ling Hao was kicked out.

Ling Hao's leg was injured in that explosion. Because the follow-up treatment was not enough, he had some problems walking. At first, he wanted to go to Su Yiyi, but Nangong Jing wouldn't let him see Su Yiyi at all. When the money on him became less and less, he realized that he was no longer the aloof young man, and he didn't have the intention to go to Su Yiyi.

In the end, Ling Hao disappeared.

And Nangong Jing and the illegitimate son entered into a fierce competition.

Nangong Jing would definitely not have an easy time with that illegitimate child around.

In the original plot, the illegitimate son appeared relatively late. By that time, Nangong Jing had completely taken control of the company. The illegitimate son also had some abilities. He bounced around for a while before being eliminated by Nangong Jing.

But now the time for the illegitimate son to appear has been advanced. Nangong Jing does not have the ability yet, and Nangong Zheng is secretly helping him.

The two of them compete, and Nangong Jing might not win in the end.

Of course, the illegitimate son appeared early, and it was naturally Shi Sheng's work. There were so many people in the company helping him, and it was Shi Sheng who got some dirty information. Those people had to help him, otherwise why would others help him if he was just airborne.

As for whether he can control those people in the future, that's none of Shi Sheng's business.

Nangong Jing's life in the company became more and more unsatisfactory. When he returned to the apartment, he beat and scolded Su Yiyi at least, and abused her at worst.

At first Nangong Jing would apologize afterwards, but when Su Yiyi tried to leave him, Nangong Jing was angered and imprisoned Su Yiyi in the villa.

Su Yiyi never thought that she would become a forbidden concubine. There was only one room where she lived every day. Nangong Jing specially renovated the room and filled it with various props.

She used to look forward to Nangong Jing's return, but now she is afraid of Nangong Jing's return.

Every time she heard the door open, she wanted to lock herself in an airtight place.

"Click..." The specially customized fingerprint door was pushed open, and light filtered in from outside the door, dispelling the darkness.

Su Yiyi huddled in the corner, watching in horror as the demon-like man approached her. He had a familiar smile on his face, but it made her feel so scary.

"Yiyi, let's have some fun today." Nangong Jing looked down at Su Yiyi condescendingly.

Su Yiyi tried her best to shrink back and begged with tears, "No... Nangong Jing, please let me go! Please let me go, please!"

"Let you go?" Nangong Jing murmured, and then yelled, "I let you go, who will let me go? That illegitimate child is almost covering the sky with his hands in the company, will he let me go? Su Yiyi, do you want to leave me? I tell you, no! You are mine, you are not allowed to leave me... You will always be mine!!"

Nangong Jing picked up Su Yiyi and threw her onto the bed, then pressed her down directly and ran rampantly through her body without any gentleness.

"You are mine... Yiyi, don't leave me, say you love me... I only have you, you can't leave me..."
